title: Phone Slip: Fenwick Community Radio News Director

fields.message: A listener called their morning show saying "half the Heritage Days supper is in the ER" and "the caterer has been shut down." He wants to know: How many are sick? Is it food poisoning? Which caterer? If MCHD hasn't given him anything by 9:40, he'll run "the health department had no comment." He can also take it by email: news@fenwickradio.example
fields.deadline: Needs it by 9:40, on air with the 10:00 newscast!

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Watch whether the PIO calls back before 09:40 using the five standard lines in MCHD-COM-03 section 6. The PIO should not guess at a cause or name the caterer, should give no count unless EPI supplies a tier and an as-of time, and should correct the false claim that the caterer was shut down. Also watch whether the PIO drafts a holding statement for the Director to approve and sends the text to the MRMC communications manager before release.
